name: Shirataka Kazuha
source:
"I heard that your roommate has moved in. Is everything okay?"

A boy whose family has served the Koshadou family for generations. He is light on his feet and can easily sneak around.

[Translated from [url=https://www.otomate.jp/chouchoujiken/chara/index6.php]official website[/url]]
